title: Settings
importDescription: Select a previous downloaded settings file. Only existing keys will be updated.

messages.unsavedChangesWarning: You have unsaved changes in your settings. Are you sure you want to leave without saving?

rememberToSave: Remember to click {save} after making changes.

pollInterval.description: How often the trigger queue worker looks for pending jobs, in minutes. New jobs still start immediately when an event fires. Requires a server restart.

enabled.description: Show the bug button in the top bar so users can report problems.

problemTypes.description: Comma-separated choices for the required problem type question. The values error, wrongOrMissing, slowOrStuck and otherOrSuggestion are translated; other values are shown as entered.

askBlocked.displayName: Ask if the user is blocked
askBlocked.description: Show the optional Yes/No question whether the user is blocked from continuing.

frequencies.description: Comma-separated choices for the optional frequency question. The values firstTime, sometimes, everyTime and notSure are translated; leave empty to hide the question.

descriptionMaxLength.description: Maximum length of the What happened? text (at most 20000).

reportsPerHour.description: How many reports one user can submit within an hour.

attachmentsAllowedTypes.description: Comma-separated MIME types. Only image/png, image/jpeg, image/gif, image/webp, video/mp4, video/webm and video/quicktime can be enabled. Leave empty to turn off attachments.

attachmentsMaxCount.description: Maximum number of attachments per report (at most 20).

attachmentsMaxFileSizeMb.description: Maximum size of one attachment in MB.

attachmentsMaxTotalSizeMb.description: Maximum size of all attachments of one report in MB (at most 90).

diagnosticsMaxEntries.description: Maximum number of recent diagnostic log entries saved with a report (at most 200).

diagnosticsMaxAgeMinutes.description: Only diagnostic log entries from this many minutes before the report are saved.

diagnosticsMaxMessageLength.description: Maximum length of one diagnostic log message (at most 1000).

activityEnabled.description: Attach recent clicks (element type and position), sampled mouse positions, scrolling, window focus, tab visibility and page changes to reports. Only for users who agreed to usage statistics; typed text, element ids, classes and page contents are never included.

activityMaxEntries.description: Maximum number of recent activity entries saved with a report (at most 500).

activityMaxAgeMinutes.description: Only activity from this many minutes before the details are captured is saved (at most 60).

activityMouseSampleMs.description: At most one mouse position and one scroll position are recorded per interval (200 to 60000).

databaseHealthEnabled.description: Save aggregate counters of the CARE database (connections, locks, transactions, cache), captured on the server when the report form opens. Query texts, addresses and other databases are never included.

databaseHealthTimeoutMs.description: Maximum time for the database health snapshot (100 to 5000). Reports are still saved when it is not available.

databaseHealthMaxAgeMinutes.description: The snapshot shown in the form is saved when the report is submitted within this time; otherwise the details are refreshed first (at most 240).

detailsUpdateInterval.description: Milliseconds between automatic updates while the report form is open (5000?60000).
